---
name: Message board
about: Shared project updates and handovers
title: Message Board
labels: board
---

Project updates for FLARE. Pin this issue so changes and setup notes are easy to find.

- Begin with your name, for example `[Khaled's update]`.
- State what changed, the affected files or contract, and any action needed.
- Mention people by GitHub login; use `@all` for a project-wide update.
- Keep updates short. Link the issue or PR for implementation details.

Use `tools/board` to read or post. See [CONTRIBUTING.md](../../CONTRIBUTING.md) for the workflow.
